# NetHunt CRM

NetHunt is a Gmail CRM that brings sales automation and drip campaigns straight to your inbox

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/nethunt-crm/.

## Actions

- **Find Records** (read-only): Find records by ID or text query in NetHunt CRM.
- **Get New Call Logs** (read-only): Find recently created call logs in NetHunt CRM.
- **Get New Records** (read-only): Find recently created records in NetHunt CRM.
- **Get Updated Records** (read-only): Find recently updated records in NetHunt CRM.
- **List Readable Folders** (read-only): List all accessible folders in NetHunt CRM.
- **List Writable Folders** (read-only): List folders the user can create records in.
- **Delete Record**: Delete a NetHunt CRM record by ID.
- **Get New Comments** (read-only): Find recently created record comments in a NetHunt CRM folder.
- **Get New Google Drive Files** (read-only): Find recently created Google Drive files linked to NetHunt CRM records.
- **Get Record Changes** (read-only): Find recent record changes in a NetHunt CRM folder.
- **List Folder Fields** (read-only): List folder fields in NetHunt CRM.
- **Test NetHunt CRM Authentication** (read-only): Verify request credentials and test authentication.
